title: pinus nigra subsp. laricio
intro: Pinus nigra subsp. laricio, commonly known as Calabrian black pine or Italian stone pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus nigra subsp. laricio include bronchodilation, mucolytic, and anti-spasmodic actions, which may help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
